author: Forbes
description:
Lottie Weaver was scrolling on TikTok in fall of 2025 when an ad stopped her cold. Aerie, the underwear brand whose pajamas she loved, appeared to be offering a massive sale, with PJs that normally cost upwards of $80 marked down to just $6. Weaver decided to get an early start on her Christmas shopping and bought $40 of discounted pajamas. She was so excited about the deal that she reposted the link to the sale site to her 700,000 Instagram followers.

Then she waited.

A month or so passed, and nothing showed up at her home in Queen Creek, Arizona. Weaver, who has more than 3 million TikTok followers, checked her credit card. She hadn’t bought anything from Aerie at all. Instead, she’d been duped by a popular scam on TikTok.

Later that year, she picked up a $400 Ralph Lauren “Polo Bear” sweater for just $40 via another TikTok ad. It never arrived either. And she’s not alone.

title: TikTok Quietly Gutted Its Advertising Rules. Scams Have Exploded Ever Since.

author: Forbes
description:
Stephen Mathew Morrow, better known by his nom de casino, Vegas Matt, looks like a caricature of a high-stakes gambler. A large, one-pound gold chain hangs around his neck with a matching bracelet on his right wrist, a Rolex SkyDweller on his left, and a Rolls-Royce Cullinan parked outside the El Cortez Hotel and Casino in Downtown Las Vegas.

As he walks the casino floor on a Tuesday afternoon in September, fans flock around him every few feet, asking for a photo, telling him how much they love him and his video content. The 62-year-old Morrow posts stories every day to his 5 million followers, including 1.7 million on YouTube and 2 million on Instagram. Two middle-aged sisters are giddy when they spot him and one says: “I go to bed with you every night.” Vegas Matt responds with quick wit: “My superpower is putting women to sleep.”

Inside the El Cortez’s high limit slot parlor, he says hello to vice president and general manager Adam Wiesberg, who acts like a shepherd for the flock
title: Inside The Wild, Lucrative World Of Vegas Matt
